messages.author: 4a0d6ff9ce3b1d6b
messages.subject: Re: several problems.
parts:
Hello, 

I think the main problem might be the second one ( Could not compute standard errors!)
Try the following things to solve this;
  1: Drop the argument of estimator ="WLSM" because this argument might be used in the case you use matrix instead of raw data.
      I think argument ordered= will make the model be estimated in WLS.  You can confirm if you succeed in the output.
  2: Confine any coefficients of observed variables in the structural equation. 
      For example,   

KSI1 =~ 1*X11 + X21 + X31 + X41 + X51 + X61
KSI2  =~ 1*X72 + X82 + X92 + X102 + X112 + X122 
ETA=~1*Z62 + Z72 + Z82 + Z92 + Z102
KSI1KSI2 =~ 1*X11X72 + X82X21 + X92X31 + X41X102 + X112X51 + X61X122
  
  in this case, the coefficients of the first observed V in each equation is confined as one. 
  By doing this, R program may get enough information to solve the equations.

As for the first one, I haven't such warning.
So I'm not sure I'm right, some variables may have enough scales to treat them continuous (it is said more than seven is enough).
So the first warning might say you put some variables in the argument ordered=c(), although you don't have to.

 I've recently had the same problem. Good luck.

Product indicators only make sense if you treat the (first-order and product) indicators as continuous.  Multiplication is a numeric operation.  You cannot multiply 2 category labels.

[1] 1 4 9

[1] NA NA NA

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: several problems.
parts: lavaan ERROR: unknown value for `estimator' argument: qml
As the message says, lavaan does not implement QML, so it is not an option.
Can methods be used WLSM ,ULSM Can methods be used in nonlinear models?

DWLS (WLSM or WLSMV) cannot.  ULSM(V) could, but only if you treat your indicators as continuous to calculate product indicators.  If you have sufficient number of categories for that to be plausible, then you are probably better off using robust ML anyway.
As for simulations,nonlinear models how are they conducted? Is it the same with SEM packages simsem?

simsem only uses lavaan or OpenMx to estimate models, unless you write your own custom estimator for the analyze= argument.  So any limitations of your estimation software are the same in simulations using simsem.
